items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I did work with him, too. ... Raymond Scott Quintet!

ctx.x: It was Busby. It was Busby Berkeley. It wasn't Vincent Minnelli, but I did work with him, too. Later. So they brought -- what was Johnny's name? The drummer that used to be with Scott -- Johnny Williams. Do you remember --the what Scott quintet?

Raymond Scott Quintet! Yeah, the drummer was named Johnny Williams, and he was supposed to be top. So they sent to New York to get him to do this, you know,but the trick in it, you know, you had to teach Mickey to play, you know, and there was a great drummer ... well,
